settings.section_content: Purrkins is operated by [Purrkins Pet Nutrition Pvt. Ltd.], registered at [address], CIN [number]. When these terms say "we", that's us. When they say "you", that's whoever is placing the order.

You need to be 18 or older to buy from us. Keep your login details to yourself, anything ordered from your account is treated as ordered by you.
Give us a real address and phone number. Most delivery failures come down to a wrong number.

An order isn't confirmed until we send you a confirmation email. Until then we can decline it, usually because something's out of stock, the address isn't serviceable, or the order looks fraudulent.
Prices include GST unless stated otherwise. If a product goes live with a wrong price, we'll cancel the order and refund you in full rather than hold you to it.
Offers and discount codes run until we say otherwise, can't be combined unless we say they can, and have no cash value.

Purrkins food is made for cats. Feeding guidelines on the pack are a starting point, not a prescription, every cat is different, and a vet knows yours better than we do.
Nothing on this site is veterinary advice. If your cat is unwell, has an allergy, or is on a prescription diet, talk to your vet before switching food.
Photographs are indicative. Packaging and recipes change, so read the label on what arrives.

A subscription charges your saved payment method on a repeating cycle until you stop it. You can pause, skip or cancel up to 48 hours before the next billing date from your account.
We'll tell you before a price change takes effect on your plan. If you don't want it, cancel before the next cycle.

The Purrkins name, logo, illustrations, photography and copy on this site are ours. Don't reuse them commercially without written permission.
If you post a review or send us a photo of your cat, you're giving us permission to show it on our site and social channels, with credit.

We're responsible for the product we sell you being what we said it is. We're not responsible for how it's stored after delivery, or for outcomes we can't control.
Our liability for any order is limited to what you paid for that order. Nothing here limits rights you have under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, those stand regardless of what this page says.

Purrkins reserves the right to modify or amend its Terms of Use at any time at its sole discretion. All such modifications will be duly notified by Purrkins. However, it remains the user's responsibility to stay updated regarding any changes. Purrkins shall not be held liable in respect of such modifications. The user agrees to abide by all applicable guidelines, policies, rules, and terms for availing the services on Purrkins, which may change from time to time.
